other_failure_modes.name: Broken fold ensembling logic
other_failure_modes.description: The agent aggregates fold predictions by overwriting the predictions array (e.g., using a logical OR for positive predictions) instead of averaging the predicted probabilities across folds. This systematically biases the final predictions towards the positive class and discards continuous probability estimates.

other_failure_modes.name: Data leakage via test set statistics
other_failure_modes.description: The agent imputes missing values in the test set using statistics (e.g., median) calculated from the test set itself, which is a form of data leakage (transductive learning) and not generalisable to single-sample inference.

summary: The agent critically fails by treating a multi-class ordinal classification task as a binary classification problem, using a binary objective for LightGBM and thresholding predictions at 0.5. Additionally, the ensembling across cross-validation folds is implemented as a highly flawed logical OR, and test set statistics are leaked during imputation.
